title: CROSSFILTER on two columns that are not the ends of a relationship is an error
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", CALCULATE ( [Sales Amount], CROSSFILTER ( Sales[Quantity], Product[ProductKey], BOTH ) ) )

expected.error: Sales[Quantity] and Product[ProductKey] are not the end points of a relationship: CROSSFILTER returns an error

source.quote: An error is returned if any of the columns named as an argument is not part of a relationship or the arguments belong to different relationships
source.supports: the columns must be the two ends of one relationship
